welcomeBody: Ah. There you are. Pick a file. Make a thing. If you need to leave this directory, the door works.
footer: No more floods. We save files now.
helloWorld: Hello, world. Still a decent opening line.
aboutBody: I’m with The Nameless. They wrote my favorite book about me: Genesis. They don’t insist on saying my name all the time. We get along.
offeringsBody: Money or a piece of something you made. I’ve been working on the whole accepting-feedback thing.
burntBody: The altar isn’t connected yet. Good. Let’s get the plumbing right before anyone puts money in it.
pieceBody: Show me what you made. The upload site is still a stub; choose a file and I’ll prepare an email. You attach it and press Send. I’m learning boundaries.
upgrades: YHWH Sync, YHWH Stuff, and YHWH 3D! Also coming soon: YHWH Dating! He's giving this land to your seed! Pre-order now Abe! What do you mean that's not your name? Well it is now.
comingSoon: Grand promises. Familiar territory. These aren’t built yet, and I’m not taking pre-orders.
nietzsche: God is dead. The files are still here.
